audit.whatIsWrong: FAVOURED 4/10 matches the 52.6% over 6935 games, but the tldr and half the prose were the generic mage template ('His burst is magic, yours is paperwork'), misgendered on top.
audit.why: The lane's real shape is one ability: Light Binding is a flat 10s at every rank, 1175 range, and it stops on the first two units it touches. Nothing else in her kit opens a trade.

audit.why: Full phases[0..6].side and content win[0..6] both read Zed on every row, and packet.levelChart agrees. Ratings 8/10 across the lane with 7/10 at 2+ items are consistent with a FAVOURED 4/10 matchup that softens as she gets range items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illumination was never mentioned. Her damage pattern is spell-then-auto: the spell charges you and the following basic attack ignites it.
audit.why: Riot passive text: 'Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage.' Flagged autoReset, and the brief's missingInteractions names it — the wind-up is the cue, not the cast.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d and the loading lines now carry the auto tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and ended in filler about the R.
audit.why: Light Binding 10s flat at 1175; Lucent Singularity 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 at 1100 with a slow zone; Final Spark 60/50/40 at 3340; Living Shadow 20s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two existing claims — whys[4] 'her R can't interrupt your dash' and spikes[1].text 'her Final Spark (R) does nothing to you mid-dash' — assert an interaction between Death Mark's untargetability and Final Spark's beam that neither kit file supports.
audit.why: Zed's R flag reads 'untargetable: dodges timed burst and executes'; Final Spark is a zone/beam, not a targeted spell. Whether untargetability avoids the beam is not in Riot's text and the brief forbids asserting it either way.
audit.corrected: Left both strings untouched and recorded them as unverified rather than rewrite around a claim I cannot source.
